description: mobilkit is a Python toolkit for analysing high-frequency human mobility traces around extreme events. Its JOSS paper and own README connect the software to urban resilience and disaster-risk management. Spatial coverage is the trace provider’s study area and temporal coverage is the observation window; the package does not publish a universal mobility dataset. The public repository reports MIT. Mobility summaries can calibrate evacuation, transport-disruption or emergency-service simulations after a hazard. A caveat is that phone-derived traces may exclude groups and have sampling or privacy limits, so measured patterns should not be treated as a full population census. The tool analyses traces, not simulating road network capacity. Data rights and access depend on the external provider. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own repository were read without obtaining private location traces or running analysis.
